dedupe_keys.name: fao high resolution cropland agreement map 30 m circa 2020 and cropland area database by country

description: This 30 m global map shows, pixel by pixel, how many of six open high resolution land cover products classify land as cropland around 2020: ESRI 10 m land cover, FROM-GLC, GLAD, GLC-FCS30, Globeland30 and ESA WorldCover. The Zenodo record says it has a simple agreement band (1 to 6) and a detailed band (1 to 63) naming the combination, built in Google Earth Engine, and a companion 2023 record gives cropland area circa 2020 for 221 countries and territories with the mean, standard error and area by agreement class. Both were published by the FAO Statistics Division with co-authors under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as 18 GeoTIFF tiles of about 21 GB with a lookup table, plus one Excel file for the country areas. Coverage is global. Caveats: agreement is not accuracy, and the source maps differ in date and definition. For simulation it gives cropland extent with a confidence level to weight agricultural exposure to floods, drought and heat. Related catalogue records include the Unified Cropland Layer 2014 and the global hybrid herbaceous cropland map for 2019.
